about: Weapons v2 art (docs/WEAPONS_V2.md): four guns, a frag grenade, four ammo icons, a crossbow bolt projectile and the explosion effect. Generate with `node art/raw/guns-v2/gen.mjs [ids…]`, post-process (inventory icons, explosion sheet, contact sheet) with `uv run --with pillow art/raw/guns-v2/post.py`.
style: Game sprite in exactly the art style of the first reference image (bright stylized cartoon like ZombsRoyale, flat colors, soft shading, thick dark outlines, chunky readable shapes).
gunStyle: Match the outline thickness, shading and level of detail of the second reference image (an existing weapon sprite of the same game), but draw a different weapon. A generic fictional design, not a copy of any real-world model, no markings.
gunView: Seen from above, gun lying flat so its side profile silhouette is visible, pointing right, the whole gun horizontal.
view: Seen STRICTLY from directly above (bird's-eye, 90 degrees top-down, NOT 3/4 or isometric view).
isolate: Centered, single isolated object filling about 70% of the frame, on a perfectly flat solid pure magenta background (#FF00FF), no gradient, no ground texture, no cast shadow, no text, no letters, no logos. Do not use any pink, magenta or purple colors on the object.

items.prompt: A compact submachine gun: short barrel with a small muzzle, a straight box magazine sticking down in front of the trigger guard, a slim pistol grip, a folded skeleton wire stock, matte black metal with a dark tan polymer handguard.

A light machine gun, long and heavy: a thick barrel with a perforated cooling shroud and a flash hider, a folded bipod under the front, a carry handle on top, a square ammo belt box hanging under the receiver with a short brass belt feeding in, a solid stock, dark gunmetal with olive drab furniture.
A big six-shot revolver: long round barrel with a top rib and a front sight, a chunky fluted cylinder, a hammer, a curved warm brown wooden grip, polished steel metal.

items.view: Seen STRICTLY from directly above, pointing right: the stock runs left to right, and the two curved bow limbs spread up and down at the front end, perpendicular to the stock.
items.prompt: A modern hunting crossbow: two thick recurved limbs with small cam wheels at the tips, a taut string pulled back to the trigger, a loaded bolt with bright green fletching resting on the rail, a small scope on top, a dark walnut wooden stock and black metal parts.

derived.icons: icon_<gun>.png for all eight guns: the world sprite rotated 30° (muzzle up-right) and fitted into a 128 px square for the inventory grid (post.py).
